The Skin Labo all-in-one gel is a versatile skincare product that offers UV protection and contains three moisturizing ingredients. Use with caution to avoid any skin problems. If you notice redness, swelling, itching, irritation, color loss (e.g., vitiligo), or darkening during or after use due to exposure to sunlight, discontinue use and consult a skin doctor or other specialist. Symptoms may worsen if use is continued. Do not use on areas with scars, rashes, eczema, or other skin problems. If it gets into eyes, rinse immediately with water or lukewarm water. If irritation persists, consult an ophthalmologist. After use, be sure to close the cap and use the product as soon as possible. Avoid high or low temperatures and direct sunlight.
